# GRPO − EI by proof length (generated by `length_split.py`; do not edit by hand)

Thinking models, GRPO recipe v2, plain reads at B64 (ynez). pass@k in % of the bin, 95%
hierarchical-bootstrap intervals over seeds and problems (4000 draws), seeds paired
(both arms start from the same Stage-1 models). Δ = GRPO arm − EI arm, in points.
Figures: `fig_length_split_*` in
`experiment-summaries/2026-10-05-thinking-traces/figures/ynez/`.

## Proof lengths

| set | problems | reference length | shortest found proof (no reference) | no length |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| textbook72 | 72 | 58 | 14 | 0 |
| Charles149 | 149 | 149 | 0 | 0 |
| 13–20 lines | 986 | 986 | 0 | 0 |
| 21–30 lines | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 0 |

- The stored 13–20, 21–30 and Charles149 reference proofs, recounted (premise lines in,
  QED out), give the stored `reference_lines` for every problem (986, 1,000, 149).
- Charles149: shortest proof the headline arms found − search-minimal reference, over the 140 problems they solved: = 0 for 131, shorter for 0, longer for 9.
- textbook72: shortest proof the headline arms found − stored reference (dev58, no proofs), over the 57 problems they solved: = 0 for 39, shorter for 14, longer for 4.
- 13–20 lines: shortest proof the headline arms found − reference, over the 963 problems they solved: = 0 for 446, shorter for 4, longer for 513.
- 21–30 lines: shortest proof the headline arms found − reference, over the 503 problems they solved: = 0 for 50, shorter for 12, longer for 441.
- So `steps` − 1 counts ND lines as `reference_lines` does (Charles149: never below the
  minimum, equal on most). The shorter found proofs mostly use Lean's ¬A = A → False or
  beat a non-minimal stored reference (textbook72's dev references are not all minimal).
- textbook72 train14, shortest found lengths: 2, 4, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 11, 11, 12, 12, 14, 20 lines.
